urgent.title: Abeg find help now now
urgent.chestPain: Chest pain fit be serious matter.
urgent.breathless: If e hard to breathe, e fit be serious matter.
urgent.bpVeryHigh: Your BP high well well (180/110 or pass am).
urgent.sugarLow: Your blood sugar don low (e no reach 70). Take something wey sweet now now, like juice or 3 teaspoon of sugar inside water.
urgent.sugarVeryHigh: Your blood sugar high well well (300 or pass am).
urgent.body: If you dey feel like you wan faint, your head no dey correct, or the pain strong, call 112 now now. If e no reach that one, talk to doctor today.

advice.bpHigh: Your BP high pass as e suppose be. Sit down quietly for 5 minutes, then check am again. If e still dey 140/90 or pass am, book doctor.
advice.bpLow: Low BP and your head dey turn: sit down or lie down, drink water, and stand up slowly slowly.
advice.sugarHigh: Your blood sugar high. Drink water, no drink sweet drink today, and talk to doctor if e still dey high.
advice.fever: For fever, rest and drink plenty water. If e pass 2 days, or you get malaria sign, see doctor.
advice.unwell3: Your body never well for 3 days now. E go good make you talk to doctor.
